description: Play one of the site's interactive demos, rebuilt from the public corpus pages that fully describe them. "interleaving": the Interleaving Explorer, two writers on one database row, six schedules, warn vs enforce mode, and the lost update with its receipts. "failure-museum": match each Agent Failure Museum exhibit (synthetic failures) to the control that catches it. Hosts that support MCP Apps render it as an interactive view; others get the same data as JSON.
name: play_demo
title: Play a portfolio demo
